latest.name: Gazeora v1.0.1-rc.1
latest.body:
A patch release candidate of Gazeora for Windows. The app is the same as v1.0.0-rc.1; this release is the first to reach [gazeora.github.io](https://gazeora.github.io/download.html) the moment it's published.

This is a pre-release. Please try it with your games and [report what you find](https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/issues/new/choose).

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Gazeora-v1.0.1-rc.1-x64.msi` | 64-bit games (most games from the last decade) |
| `Gazeora-v1.0.1-rc.1-x86.msi` | 32-bit games, including every Direct3D 8 game and many older Direct3D 9 and OpenGL ones |

Windows 10 or 11. Installs over v1.0.0-rc.1, keeping your library and settings. To watch on your phone, get [Gazeora for Android](https://gazeora.github.io/download.html).

## What changed since v1.0.0-rc.1

- Every release is now sent to the website as it's published, edited or deleted, with its files and checksums.
- The release steps in the development guide describe this.

See the [guides](https://gazeora.github.io/docs.html) to get started.
